records.process_description: Students in the MA program must write a two‑semester Master’s thesis (Modul 06SM640‑MA, 30 ECTS). The module is self‑booked; submission deadlines are 01.06 or 01.12 (see “Modul Masterarbeit an der PhF”). Discuss the topic in a supervisor’s Sprechstunde before booking; supervisors must teach in the Major/Mono programme, hold a doctorate and be employed at UZH. The thesis is an independent written work of 60–90 pages (text with footnotes, excl. appendix and bibliography); cover sheet and formalities follow institute practice. Submit electronically to the Studiendekanat; whether a printed/pdf copy is needed is to be agreed with the supervisor. Graduation must be applied for via the “Studienfortschritt & -abschluss” app; consult the Modulkatalog, VVZ, PhF pages (“Abschluss des Studiums”), Studienordnung and KHIST Studienprogrammberatung for full rules. Requests for withdrawal or extension follow §24/§25 RVO.
